object_types.name: Shipment
object_types.definition: A consignment of products moving through the logistics network

source_references.excerpt: We track shipments -- consignments, some of the older staff say, same thing. Each shipment has a shipment number.

object_types.name: Product
object_types.definition: An item that can be included in a shipment, identified by SKU

source_references.excerpt: A shipment contains products, each in a specific quantity. Products are identified by SKU.

object_types.name: Warehouse
object_types.definition: A physical facility where shipments can be located

source_references.excerpt: A shipment can be split across warehouses -- up to three warehouses per shipment. Warehouses have a warehouse code.

object_types.name: Quantity
object_types.definition: The amount of a product held within a shipment line

source_references.excerpt: A shipment contains products, each in a specific quantity.
